title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“老爷，要不我替你去吧！”苗翠花突然眼前一亮，开口道。“笑话！”方德猛地一挥手，“此次北上，是迎接红花会新任总舵主，为此，红花会的十四位当家，会千里接龙头！你什么身份什么地位，如何够资格参与如此重大的盛会？”“这……”苗翠花一脸不忿，但是她也知道红花会“千里接龙头”仪式的重要性，她一介女流之辈，无论如何都不能代替方德参加如此盛会！这时，在一旁旁听许久的方言突然开口道：“大伯伯，大妈妈，不如我去吧！”“哦？”两人俱是一愣，转头看向了方言。“这……”方德有些犹豫，“言儿你是我侄儿，你父亲也对红花会有大恩，所以你的身份倒是够资格。但是你不是一直都不愿意和红花会扯上关系的吗，怎么这次……”方言微笑开口道：“我此次北上，并非为了那劳什子千里接龙头，而是为了让我大伯免去那奔波之苦！”说着，方言顿了一下，开口道：“再说，有大伯和我父亲这层关系在，我和红花会又如何能断的了关系？”方德闻言，眼眶登时一红，口中颤抖：“孩子……”方言笑着阻止方德煽情，开口道：“这些年，要不是大伯伯和大妈妈，我恐怕早已化作冢中枯骨，现在能为大伯做些事情，我亦是开心不已！”方德还是有些犹豫：“红花会千里接龙头声势浩大，朝廷不可能一点风声都收不到，到时候恐怕会有许多危险……”方言闻言，笑得更加灿烂：“那我就更应该去了！我有功夫在身，碰见危险还有自保的能力，如果换成大伯你，那可就真的危险了！”“可是……”方德还想再说着什么。苗翠花见状出言劝道：“老爷，我觉得言儿说的不错，以言儿的武功，天下之大，哪里去不得？此行他去比你去要安全的多！”“哦？言儿的武功这么厉害吗？”方德诧异的问道。也不怪方德有如此一问，他本身就不通拳脚，所以对方言的功夫好坏也没有一个概念。“红花会的几个当家都和言儿切磋过武艺，言儿剑法不输二当家无尘道长，拳脚胜过三当家‘千手如来’赵半山，于老舵主曾夸言儿是一百年来武学天赋第一！”苗翠花说着这些话的时候，脸上的表情十分的骄傲，仿佛取得这些成绩的是她自己一样！“什么？”方德脸上的惊讶之情溢于言表。虽然不通拳脚，但是“追魂夺命剑”无尘道长和“千手如来”赵半山的名号他也是听说过的，都是江湖上赫赫有名的绝顶高手！言儿居然能和他们打成平手？这岂不是说言儿也是绝顶高手？

不对，以言儿的年纪，说他是江湖第一人都不为过！“些许微末伎俩，不值一提！”方言脸上露出恰到好处的微笑，谦虚地说道。“言儿你也太谦虚了，要是言儿你的武功都是微末伎俩的话，那我们岂不是连庄稼把势都算不上？”苗翠花笑着说道。“还是不行，言儿虽然武功高超，但是毕竟初出茅庐，没有一点江湖经验，很容易就会着了小人的道儿！”方德还是有些抗拒。“大伯伯，不妨事儿的，此次北上，我会和文泰来骆冰夫妇二人同行，他们二人可是老江湖了，一定能保证此行安全无虞！”方言说道。“这……”方德再也想不出拒绝的理由。“大伯伯，就这么定了！”方言说道，“况且，沿途我还可以打听妹妹的消息，也不算白出门一趟！”“那……好吧！”方德点点头欣慰地说道，然后他从怀里掏出一本红色的折子，“这是红花会广州分会的人员名册，切记切记，一定要亲手交到陈总舵主手里，绝对不能落到旁人手中！”“放心吧！”方言将折子塞进怀里，郑重答应道。次日清早，方言背上行囊，配好长剑，牵着一匹骏马，向方德夫妇辞行。“言儿，”苗翠花将一张百两银票和一包散碎银子塞进了方言手中，“穷家富路，你这第一次出远门，路上该吃吃，该喝喝，千万不要委屈自己。还有啊，切记财不露白，防止被宵小之徒盯上……”儿行千里母担忧，虽然苗翠花不是方言亲娘，但是她从小将方言养大，早就和方言亲娘无异。方言耐心的听着苗翠花唠叨，一点也不嫌烦。倒是一边的方德嫌弃苗翠花啰嗦，拉着她的手将她拽到了身后。“多余的话大伯伯也不说了，”方德郑重嘱咐道，“切记切记，安全第一，遇见危险马上就跑，就算名册丢了也不要紧……”“行了行了，你这老倌儿恁地话多，有我奔雷手文泰来在，哪里会有什么危险？”等在一旁的壮汉不耐烦的打断了方德的叮嘱，随后对着方言说，“快点上路吧，我们这次要去西北，路上几千里，要走大半个月，哪里还有时间耽搁！”说话的人正是红花会的四当家，“奔雷手”文泰来，精擅“霹雳掌”，使动时掌风与喝声同作，隐隐蓄有风雷之势，掌力沉雄，如同霹雳。他身旁牵着马的俏丽女子，正是他的发妻，“鸳鸯刀”骆冰，独行大盗“神刀”骆元通之女，擅用鸳鸯双刀和飞刀。骆冰方言不动声色的看向了文泰来，眼中闪过一丝寒光。他向来是看不惯这个红花会的四当家，虽然他豪迈大气，极具英雄气概，但是他也有着江湖莽汉的常见缺点，比方说言语粗鄙，比方说刚愎自用。当然，最可恶的是，就这么一个满脑子都是肌肉的莽汉，居然娶了骆冰这么一个美娇娘，端的是不当人子。怪不得后世有文人骚客，以骆冰为主角，描述了救出文泰来之后的故事，塑造了一个有血有肉的坚强侠女形象，让人看完以后瞠目张口，喉干舌燥，躁动不安，恨不得穿入书中，和女侠骆冰一起闯“荡”江湖！

"Master, how about I go for you!" Miao Cuihua's eyes suddenly lit up and she said."Joke!" Fang De waved his hand fiercely, "This trip north is to welcome the new chief helmsman of the Red Flower Club. For this reason, the fourteen heads of the Red Flower Club will travel thousands of miles to meet the leader! What is your identity and status, and how can you be qualified to participate in such an important event?" "This..." Miao Cuihua looked unhappy, but she also knew the importance of the Red Flower Club's "Thousands of Miles to meet the leader" ceremony. As a female, she could not participate in such a grand event on Fang De's behalf!At this time, Fang Yan, who had been listening for a long time, suddenly said: "Uncle, eldest mother, how about I go!" "Oh?" Both of them were stunned and turned to look at Fang Yan."This..." Fang De hesitated, "Yan'er, you are my nephew, and your father is also very kind to the Honghua Society, so your status is quite qualified. But haven't you always been unwilling to have anything to do with the Honghua Society? Why this time..." Fang Yan smiled and said, "I went north this time not for that reason.Lao Shizi traveled thousands of miles to save my uncle from the pain of running around!" After saying that, Fang Yan paused and said, "Besides, how can I break off the relationship between my uncle and my father?" Fang De's eyes suddenly turned red when he heard this, and his mouth trembled: "Child...Fang Yan smiled and stopped Fang De from being sensational, and said: "In these years, if it weren't for my uncle and my eldest mother, I would have turned into a withered skeleton in the grave. Now I can do something for my uncle, and I am very happy!"Fang De still hesitated: "The Red Flower Club has taken the lead thousands of miles away, and it is impossible for the court to make any noise.I can't hear the sound, and I'm afraid there will be many dangers..." Fang Yan smiled even brighter when he heard this: "Then I should go!I have the skills and the ability to protect myself when encountering danger.If it were you, uncle, it would be really dangerous!" "But..." Fang De wanted to say something else.Seeing this, Miao Cuihua advised: "Master, I think what Yan'er said is right. With Yan'er's martial arts, the world is so big, where can he go? It will be much safer for him to go than for you to go!" "Oh? Is Yan'er's martial arts so powerful?" Fang De asked in surprise.It's no wonder that Fang De asked such a question. He himself was not good at boxing and kicking, so he had no idea about Fang Yan's kung fu."Several masters of the Red Flower Club have competed with Yan'er in martial arts. Yan'er's swordsmanship is not inferior to that of the second master Wu Chen, and his fists and kicks are better than those of the third master's 'Thousand-Armed Tathagata' Zhao Banshan. The old helmsman Yu once praised Yan'er as the best martial arts talent in a hundred years!" When Miao Cuihua said these words, the expression on her face was very proud, as if she was the one who achieved these results!"What?" The surprise on Fang De's face was beyond words.Although he didn't know how to use fists and kicks, he had heard of the names of "Soul-Chasing and Life-Destroying Sword" Wuchen Taoist Priest and "Thousand-Armed Tathagata" Zhao Banshan, both of whom were well-known masters in the world!Yan'er could actually get a tie with them?Doesn't this mean that Yan'er is also a top expert?

No, given Yan'er's age, it's not an exaggeration to say that he is the number one person in the world!"A few trivial tricks are not worth mentioning!" Fang Yan said modestly with a well-placed smile on his face."Yan'er, you are too modest. If your martial arts skills, Yan'er, are all just tricks, then wouldn't we be able to even control crops?" Miao Cuihua said with a smile."It still doesn't work. Although Yan'er has superb martial arts skills, after all, he is just a fledgling and has no experience in the world. It is easy for him to fall into the trap of villains!" Fang De still resisted."Uncle, it's okay. On this trip north, I will go with Wen Tailai and Luo Bing. They are old people, so they will definitely ensure a safe trip!" Fang Yan said."This..." Fang De could no longer think of a reason to refuse."Uncle, it's settled!" Fang Yan said, "Besides, I can also inquire about my sister along the way, so it's not a wasted trip!" "Then... okay!" Fang De nodded and said happily, and then he took out a book from his armsThe red folder said, "This is the personnel roster of the Guangzhou branch of the Red Flower Society. Remember, it must be handed over to Mr. Chen in person and must not fall into the hands of others!" "Don't worry!" Fang Yan stuffed the folder into his arms and solemnly promised.Early the next morning, Fang Yan packed up his luggage, equipped himself with a long sword, led a horse, and bid farewell to Fang De and his wife."Yan'er," Miao Cuihua put a hundred taels of silver notes and a bag of loose silver into Fang Yan's hand, "You come from a poor family, and this is your first time traveling far away. You should eat and drink on the way, so don't wrong yourself. Also, remember not to expose your wealth to avoid being targeted by young people..." Er Xing Qianli's mother was worried. Although Miao Cuihua was not Fang Yan's mother, she had raised Fang Yan since she was a child, and she was no different from Fang Yan's mother.Fang Yan listened patiently to Miao Cuihua's chatter without feeling annoyed at all.Fang De, on the other hand, disliked Miao Cuihua's nagging, so he took her hand and dragged her behind him."Uncle, I won't say anything unnecessary," Fang De solemnly warned, "Remember, safety first, run away immediately when in danger. It doesn't matter even if the roster is lost..." "Okay, okay, you are such a talkative old coward. With me, Thunder Runner Wen Tailai, how can there be any danger?" The strong man waiting aside impatiently interrupted Fang De's words.He asked, and then said to the dialect, "Hurry up and get on the road. We are going to the northwest this time. The journey is thousands of miles and it will take more than half a month. There is no time to delay!" The person who spoke was the fourth leader of the Red Flower Club, Wen Tailai, the "Thunder Hand", who was good at "Thunder Palm". When he used it, the wind and the shout were at the same time, with the potential of wind and thunder, and the force of the palm was like a thunderbolt.The pretty woman holding the horse beside him is his first wife, "Yuanyang Sword" Luo Bing, the daughter of the lone thief "Magic Sword" Luo Yuantong, who is good at using Yuanyang's twin swords and flying knives.Luo Bingyan looked at Wen Tailai calmly, with a cold light flashing in his eyes.He has always disliked the fourth leader of the Red Flower Club. Although he is heroic and heroic, he also has the common shortcomings of a rough man, such as vulgar language and stubbornness.Of course, the most disgusting thing is that such a brash man with a head full of muscles actually married a beautiful girl like Luo Bing, not being a son of a man.No wonder there are literary poets in later generations, with Luo Bing as the protagonist, describing the story after rescuing Wen Tailai, and creating a flesh-and-blood image of a strong chivalrous heroine. After reading it, people will be stunned, their throats will be dry, their tongues will be dry, and they will be restless. They can't wait to slip into the book and "dang" with the heroine Luo Bing!
